findings.summary: The pinned, unchanged vgpu Node 22 workload passed all three clean Dawn processes, including its ONNX model hash, GPU-resident output gate, numeric oracle, zero-copy identity, copy counts, and lifecycle assertions.

A minimized provider probe and all three unchanged application processes show that ONNX Runtime Web assigns GPUDevice.onuncapturederror while Doe's Node provider setter rejects that standard device capability before inference begins; Dawn accepts the same setter.
Dawn selected llvmpipe after the physical render node denied access, and Doe did not complete the workload, so the observed process durations cannot support a speed comparison.

limitations: Doe failed before ORT inference, vgpu dispatch, synchronization, readback, numeric comparison, and lifecycle teardown could execute.
The host denied access to /dev/dri/renderD128 and Dawn selected llvmpipe, so the run is not hardware-comparable.
Doe's adapter description identifies its runtime route but does not expose the underlying physical adapter and driver identity on this host.
The result covers the pinned Node ORT integration workload, not vgpu's browser renderer or complete API surface.

performance.reason: The comparison provider did not complete the workload and the baseline used a software renderer.

receiptOverhead.reason: Doe failed before a matched traced and untraced workload pair could complete.

installation.summary: The ESM provider loader is a controlled harness substitution, not a validated production installation path.

supportHardware.summary: The physical render node was inaccessible and Dawn selected llvmpipe.

concurrency.summary: The diagnostic matrix did not execute concurrent processes.

teardown.summary: The baseline exercised upstream lifecycle assertions, but no promotion-scale teardown lane ran and Doe never reached teardown.

stress.summary: Three clean processes per provider diagnose repeatability but do not satisfy the promotion stress policy.

memory.summary: Peak RSS was captured, but no bounded-growth leak test ran.

receipts.summary: The harness captured provider and adapter identities plus the deterministic failure boundary, but Doe produced no dispatch, synchronization, readback, or output receipt.

performance.summary: The comparison did not complete and the incumbent used software rendering.

release.summary: The harness is not promoted and Doe does not yet pass its correctness boundary.

ownership.summary: The I0/I1/W0/D0 ownership comparison and ownership-cost adjudication were not run.

runtimeOwnershipAssessment.summary: The retained diagnostic predates the frozen runtime-ownership comparison and cannot establish DoeRuntime attribution.
